visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a first-person perspective from a kayak moving across bright blue ocean waves under a clear sky. A young woman with a sun hat and floral sleeves is seen paddling in a separate kayak nearby. Yellow and white Traditional Chinese text overlays appear in the center of the frame. The scene then cuts to a night-time glamping site where a group of people is gathered under a camouflage tent. Various meats, squids, and large prawns are being grilled on a charcoal BBQ, emitting a warm glow from the red-hot coals. (2) The setting shifts to the interior of a luxury camping trailer, showcasing a tidy room with a large white bed, wooden wall panels, and a wall-mounted flat-screen television. Outside, a young child in a blue hat plays with a water gun in a small swimming pool. The camera then captures a sunrise kayaking trip, with the golden sun reflecting on the calm sea as several kayaks paddle toward a massive rock formation known as Wuyan Cape. The characters wear life vests and use yellow paddles, with the camera capturing the rugged cliffs and deep blue water. (3) On a secluded pebble beach, a group of people is seen exploring the shoreline near a large sea cave. The scene cuts to an ATV sequence where the main characters, wearing helmets, drive red and blue all-terrain vehicles through a shallow riverbed and muddy tracks, creating large water splashes. Later, a zipline activity is shown, where a woman holds a selfie stick while sliding over a lush green forest canopy. The video concludes with a group shot of the travelers waving on their ATVs and aerial drone footage of the hidden beach and the camping site.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a rapid, high-energy synthesizer pop BGM featuring a driving electronic drum beat. A female narrator speaks with an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone in Traditional Chinese. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to the glamping scene. The sound of crackling charcoal and sizzling food is briefly audible beneath the voiceover. (3) During the kayaking segment, a subtle liquid splash sound effect is layered over the music. The narrator's pitch rises as she describes the sunrise. (4) As the ATVs appear, a low-frequency engine revving noise and the sound of heavy water splashing are mixed into the track. (5) A mechanical whirring sound (zipline cable friction) triggers a new phase, accompanied by group laughter and high-arousal cheering. (6) A distinct 'hissing' water spray sound is heard near the end, followed by the narrator delivering a clear, professional-grade call to action as the music swells slightly before a hard cut to silence.
